title: Navigator
description: A pathfinding mod to get your way to a player or a location (X, Y, Z) easily!
body:
# Nav (1.21.9 to 1.21.10 (For now ;))  

This mod helps you walk towards a specific points on the map, showing a path if you are too bored thinking!

### Features  
 **Real-time path updating** – You moved away? The path still tries the best to lead you there!
 **Customizable Settings** – You have a boat? Then path will also try to be on the water!

--- 

### Commands
- Every commands are under the /nav.
  - /nav to X Y Z (To show a path towards the coordinate given)
  - /nav player (player) will make a path towards another player
  - /nav settings boat (on/off) to unable boat pathfinding!
  - /nav settings laser size `size of laser (0.3 default)`
  - /nav settings laser speed `tick before it updates (1 for fast, 20 for one second)
  - /nav stop (to stop) 

--- 

### Screenshots
![Nice](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/19877bc5b4d7bb5f138b436155f07bfb6c968cc4.png)

##  Additional Information  
- This mod does **not** automate walking or uses an automatic walking algorithm.
